items.headline: Estonia rail border band karne par vichaar
items.detail: Pradhan Mantri Kristen Michal ne kaha Estonia Narva rail crossing band karne par vichaar kar raha hai; 1 December se sadak seema band ho rahi hai, GRU tod-fod koshish ke baad.
items.exam_angle: NATO-Russia tanaav, Baltic suraksha — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Nenea hartia, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: America ki Houthi hamle se chetavni
items.detail: America ke Videsh Vibhag ne Madhya Poorv me apne nagrikon ko Houthi hamlo aur Iran ke khatre ko dekhte hue satark rehne ko kaha; udaan radd aur hawai-kshetra band hone ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran tanaav, Houthi hamle — West Asia

items.headline: Shenzhou-24 uda, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri
items.detail: Cheen ke Shenzhou-24 ne Jiuquan se udaan bhari; Pakistan ke Zeeshan Ali Tiangong station par jaane wale pehle videshi antariksh-yatri bane, ek hafte ke mission par.
items.exam_angle: Tiangong station, pehla videshi antariksh-yatri — UPSC S&T

items.headline: Mississippi ke paas viman gira, 6 lapata
items.detail: New Orleans se Fort Myers ja raha Cessna viman Horn Island ke paas samudra me gira; 4 vayask aur 2 bachche sawaar the, Coast Guard talaash me juta hai.

items.headline: Huawei doshi: 12 me se 10 aarop sabit
items.detail: Brooklyn ki jury ne Huawei ko Iran pratibandh ullanghan, bank dhokhadhadi aur trade secret chori ke 12 me se 10 aaropon me doshi thahraya; racketeering aarop se bari, saza September 2027 me.
items.exam_angle: America-Cheen tech yuddh, pratibandh — UPSC IR

items.headline: CIA-ODNI ke khule network me sendh
items.detail: America ki CIA aur ODNI ke khule-source khufiya network me sendh lagi, kuchh avargeekrit jankari ujagar hui; New York Times ne report kiya, gopniya jankari surakshit rahi.
items.exam_angle: Cyber suraksha, OSINT — UPSC IR/S&T

items.headline: Sarkozy-Brunni par naya mukadma chalega
items.detail: France ke poorv Rashtrapati Nicolas Sarkozy aur unki patni Carla Bruni par gawah se bayan badalwane ke aarop me mukadma chalega; pehli sunvai 1 April 2027 ko.
items.exam_angle: France rajneeti, bhrashtachar — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Georges-Francis Seingry, CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Yemen me bus-truck par hamla, 26 mare
items.detail: Somvaar ko Yemen ke Lahj prant me bus aur truck par hawai hamle me 26 log mare gaye — 12 Houthi ladake aur 14 nagrik; hamle ke liye Houthi Saudi ko aur sarkar Houthi ko zimmedaar thahra rahi hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen griha yuddh, Saudi-Houthi — UPSC IR

items.headline: Philippines ko America se $2.4 arab raksha sauda
items.detail: Philippines ke raksha mantri ne pushti ki America $2 arab ke vitt aur $40 crore ke anudan se samvedansheel raksha hathiyaar bechega; Dakshin Cheen Sagar me raksha kshamata badhegi.
items.exam_angle: America-Philippines raksha sauda, Dakshin Cheen Sagar — UPSC IR

items.headline: UAE bus-takkar me 13 mare, Bharatiya bhi
items.detail: Ras Al Khaimah me 41 yatriyon wali bus khadi truck se takra gayi; 13 log mare, 14 ghayal; Dubai sthit Bharatiya vanijya dutavas ne pushti ki Bharatiya nagrik bhi mare gaye.

items.headline: Shanghai ke party pramukh Chen Jining jaanch me
items.detail: China ki sarkari Xinhua ne kaha Shanghai ke party pramukh aur Politburo sadasya Chen Jining 'gambhir anushasan ullanghan' ke sandeh me jaanch ke dayre me hain; 2025 se chauthe Politburo sadasya par jaanch.
items.exam_angle: China ki rajneeti, Xi ka bhrashtachar-virodhi abhiyan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Riyadh ke vittiya jile ki tower par hamla
items.detail: Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne kaha Riyadh ke King Abdullah Financial District ki tower par 'aatankwadi hamla' hua; 11 log ghayal hue jinme 2 Bharatiya bhi hain, Civil Defence ne bataya.
items.exam_angle: Houthi-Saudi tanaav, West Asia — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Faisal Arif, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Zelensky ab Congress se madad mangenge
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha agar Trump saal-ant tak Putin se shanti samjhota na kara paye to Ukraine nayi Democrat-niyantrit Congress se sainya madad aur sakht pratibandh mangega.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine yuddh, America rajneeti — UPSC IR

items.headline: Finland khadi me Russia ke jahaz par hamla
items.detail: Zelensky ne pushti ki Ukraine ne Shanivaar ko Finland ki khadi me Russia ke cargo jahaz Sparta II par drone hamla kiya; Norway ne savdhani baratne ko kaha.
items.exam_angle: Baltic Sagar, NATO-Russia tanaav — UPSC IR

items.headline: Hormuz me chautha tanker bhi mine se takraya
items.detail: Update: Mangalvaar ko Hormuz ke poorvi hisse me chautha tanker bhi mine se takrakar aag ki lapet me aa gaya; IRGC ke mutabik pichhle 24 ghante me 5 jahaz mine se takraye, jabki UK samudri agency ne 3 jahazon par hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz — duniya ki tel supply ka raasta

items.headline: Ukraine ne Russia ki refinery par hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ke General Staff ne pushti ki 23 November ko drone hamle me Perm ki Lukoil refinery, Rostov ki Novoshakhtinsk refinery aur Tatarstan ke Kaleykino pumping station ko nuksan pahuncha; Perm refinery seema se lagbhag 1,500 km door hai.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia yuddh, tel par hamle — UPSC IR

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas suraksha pramukh mara gaya
items.detail: Mangalvaar ko Gaza City me Israeli drone hamle me Hamas ke internal security pramukh Naeem Abu Nahel samet 7 log mare gaye; IDF aur Shin Bet ne hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhaviram ke bawjood hamle — West Asia tanaav

items.headline: Libya me Ukraine ne Russia ka yuddh-pot duboya
items.detail: Ravivaar ko Benghazi bandargah par Ukraine ke 7 samudri drone ne Russia ki corvette Merkuriy ko duboya aur Angara jahaz ko nuksan pahunchaya; Zelensky ne isey 'exemplary operation' kaha.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine ki long-range strike kshamata, Libya sangharsh — UPSC IR
items.image_credit: Ministry of Defense of Russia, CC BY 4.0, Wikimedia Commons

items.headline: Landmine se hatahat 5 saal me sabse zyada
items.detail: Landmine Monitor 2026 ke mutabik 2025 me 6,929 log mare ya ghayal hue — 5 saal me sabse zyada; 84% nagrik, aadhe bachche; Myanmar (1,891) aur Syria (1,602) sabse aage.
items.exam_angle: Landmine Monitor 2026, Mine Ban Treaty — UPSC IR

items.headline: Serbia school me golibari, 2 ghayal
items.detail: Kragujevac ke First Technical School me 17 saal ke chhatra ne rifle se goli chalayi; ek karmchari ko goli lagi, dusra kanch se ghayal hua, koi chhatra ghayal nahi hua aur hamlaawar giraftaar hai.

items.headline: Sanofi kharedega Insmed, $41 billion ka sauda
items.detail: France ki Sanofi ne America ki Insmed ko $41 billion me khareedne ka samjhauta kiya, saans ki bimariyon ki dawaon ke liye; sauda 2027 ki pehli chhamahi me band hone ki ummeed hai.
items.exam_angle: Teen saal ki sabse badi pharma deal — economy

items.headline: Shein ko $100 million jurmana
items.detail: America ki FTC ne kaha Shein $100 million dega — der se delivery, nakaratmak review dabane aur kapas ki utpatti par galat daavon ke aarop; Shein ne zimmedaari nahi mani.
items.exam_angle: America upbhokta suraksha, FTC — UPSC economy

items.headline: Bangladesh me garment mazdooron ka pradarshan
items.detail: Gazipur me vetan badhane ki mang par hazaron garment mazdooron ne highway roka; police ne aansu gas aur sound grenade chhode, 70 se zyada factory band hui; mazdoor nyuntam vetan 12,500 se badhakar 30,000 taka chahte hain.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh garment udyog, shramik vetan — UPSC IR

items.headline: Nepal me 5.4 ka bhookamp, Bharat me jhatke
items.detail: USGS ke mutabik Nepal ke Koshi prant me subah 7:02 baje 5.4 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya; Bharat, Bhutan, Bangladesh aur Cheen me jhatke mehsoos hue; ab tak koi hatahat ya nuksan ki khabar nahi.
items.exam_angle: Himalaya bhookamp kshetra — UPSC geography
